read_author_definition: 20261114-atlas-known-control01/survey-readme.md: Sheet check uses fraction of 512px tiles with median crossness >=.31, pass fraction >=.40. This is an empirical heuristic, not proof of a physical sheet.

observations.p191_a: Upper-left broad merged response adjacent to CT gap, isolated points on right. No independent stroke sequence selected.
observations.PHerc0257_3549_4692_13210: Connected blobs along upper boundary, coarse patches near central dark oblique boundary; lower-right patches have varying width/direction.
observations.PHerc0268_9054_2867_6674: Isolated responses and broad short vertical patches near cracks; no continuous line selected.

decision: No justification from these three processed cards for committing CT/model resources to a specific readable region.
limits: Cards are processed JPEGs containing agreed top responses restricted to a heuristic sheet mask.
Not a native continuous-probability negative result.
No claim of ink absence or failure of the entire scroll.
Card-pixel to native coordinate mapping and physical sheet identity are unverified.
